content.tagline: Korean fragrance and personal-care brand DAILY COMMA
content.descriptor: AD International: Korean OEM/ODM manufacturer behind DAILY COMMA — perfume mists, eau de parfum, solid perfume, hair perfume, hand and body care, and home diffusers
about: AD International (ADI International Co., Ltd.) is a Korean OEM/ODM manufacturer of cosmetics and air fresheners. The company has made products for established South Korean brands for many years, and its research center continues to develop eco-friendly formulas.

DAILY COMMA is its own fragrance and personal-care brand: perfume mists, two eau de parfum lines, hand and body wash and lotion, hand cream, solid perfume and perfume balm, hair perfume, a deodorant mist, and reed and gradient-bottle home diffusers.

The brand is run by AD International Corp. (CEO Semin Ahn); the company is registered in Korea under No. 214-86-62706, based in Paju, Gyeonggi-do. The brand has an official Instagram account (@dailycomma_official) and YouTube channel (AD International).
